grade_rationale: Exploitable auth bypass (DEP-002, CVSS 9.1) + RCE in build chain (DEP-001 CVSS 9.8, DEP-004) + 22% spec coverage. Triggers config.grading F condition: exploitable auth bypass + critical domain failure.
skip_reason: Backend (localhost:3001) and Frontend (localhost:5173) offline — dynamic tests require live services

escalations.title: Proxy-addr IP Spoofing / Auth Bypass
escalations.description: proxy-addr allows IP address spoofing via forged X-Forwarded-For headers, bypassing IP-based access controls in Express. Network-adjacent attacker, no auth required.

escalations.title: Handlebars Arbitrary Code Execution (RCE)
escalations.description: Handlebars RCE via prototype pollution/code generation in Jest 29 transitive dependency chain. Exploitable during test runs and CI builds.

escalations.title: Tinypool Arbitrary Code Execution
escalations.description: Arbitrary code execution in Tinypool worker-thread pool, exploitable via crafted test modules during Vitest frontend test runs.

escalations.title: Vite Path Traversal + Source Code Exposure
escalations.description: Vite dev-server allows path traversal to read arbitrary files from the host filesystem. Source maps may expose full source code in CI artefacts.

escalations.title: React Router Open Redirect (protocol-relative URL reinterpretation)
escalations.description: Protocol-relative URL reinterpretation in react-router-dom v6 allows same-origin redirects to be rewritten as open redirects, enabling phishing attacks.

findings.title: Traceability gate reports false PASSED — masks 94 unimplemented requirements
findings.description: traceability-enforcer.py scans only the most-recently-modified requirements.md (self-judging-workflow, fully implemented). Seven other plans with 94 unimplemented requirements are silently skipped.
findings.recommendation: Update enforcer to scan all plans; update CLAUDE.md gate command.

findings.title: GET /api/search never registered in app.ts — DependencyPicker broken
findings.description: FR-dependency-search requires GET /api/search for DependencyPicker typeahead. Route never registered. test file documents it will FAIL until implemented.
findings.recommendation: Create Source/Backend/src/routes/search.ts and register in app.ts.

findings.title: FR-001 through FR-069 entirely unimplemented in Source/
findings.description: 69 FRs across Feature Request, Bug Report, Dev Cycle, Dashboard, and Pipeline APIs have zero // Verifies: comments in Source/. Spec lifecycle status undeclared.
findings.recommendation: Add lifecycle status to spec; if active, create TheFixer implementation backlog.

findings.title: FR-ID format mismatch in dependency-linking plan vs source code
findings.description: Plan uses numeric IDs (FR-0002..FR-0007); source uses semantic IDs (FR-dependency-service etc). Enforcer reports all 7 as missing.
findings.recommendation: Standardise FR-IDs or add alias comments in source.

findings.title: Two eslint-disable suppressions hide potential stale-closure bugs
findings.description: eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps silences exhaustive-deps rule, masking stale-closure risk in useEffect/useCallback. CLAUDE.md prohibits eslint-disable comments.
findings.recommendation: Fix dependency arrays or document intentional suppression with code-review sign-off.

findings.title: Traceability enforcer silently exits 0 when no requirements file found
findings.description: Missing requirements file produces exit 0 (success) instead of exit 1 (failure). CI gate is silently green when plan is misconfigured.
findings.recommendation: Change to sys.exit(1) unless --no-fail-on-missing flag is passed.

findings.title: Specifications have no lifecycle status markers
findings.description: None of the three specification files contain ACTIVE/SUPERSEDED/DRAFT status markers. Teams cannot determine which specs govern the current implementation.
findings.recommendation: Add Status: ACTIVE | SUPERSEDED | DRAFT | PLANNED frontmatter to each spec.
